description: This file defines the internal class 'OutsideRuntimeClient' which implements multiple interfaces such as IRuntimeClient, IDisposable, and IClusterConnectionStatusListener. It contains logic for managing client communication, message handling, callbacks, and connection status notifications within the Orleans distributed runtime.

classes.name: OutsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: An internal class managing client-side runtime communication, message handling, callbacks, and connection status within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: ConsumeServices
methods.description: Initializes internal components and services for the client runtime.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Begins the asynchronous startup process of the client.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the client, disposing resources and stopping associated services.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages based on their type (response, request, one way).

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message back to a requester.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Send a request message to a target grain reference.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming response messages, triggering callbacks or cancellations.

methods.name: UnregisterCallback
methods.description: Removes a callback from the internal callback dictionary.

methods.name: ConstructorReset
methods.description: Resets the object state, typically after an exception during construction.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current response timeout duration.

methods.name: SetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Sets the response timeout duration.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a given object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a previously created grain reference for an object.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the runtime client, releasing resources.

methods.name: BreakOutstandingMessagesToSilo
methods.description: Marks all pending messages to a dead silo as target failed.

methods.name: GetRunningRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ongoing requests for a specified grain interface type.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies observers that cluster connection has been lost.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of a change in the number of gateways.

methods.name: MonitorCallbackExpiry
methods.description: Periodically checks for expired callbacks and handles timeouts.

methods.name: ThrowIfDisposed
methods.description: Throws an ObjectDisposedException if the client has been disposed.
